subject: OliveTech evaluation cadence & requested cutover extension
messages:
From: Samir Iqbal <samir@olivetech.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: OliveTech Procurement <procurement@olivetech.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OliveTech evaluation cadence & requested cutover extension

Dylan / Kimberly —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We finished our internal pilot run over the past three days and have two hard blockers before we can commit to the original 2026-08-01 cutover: procurement / PO timing and our security operations team needs to complete a short SOC2 artifact review.

High level asks:
- Can Redwood push the cutover to 2026-09-01 to give procurement time for signatures and our security team two weeks to validate evidence?
- Can you share a concise MAP with updated milestones (security signoff, pilot acceptance, procurement PO, onboarding window)?
- If the date moves, will Redwood hold current pricing and commit to a one-week onboarding window for our infra team?

We want to avoid breaking the pilot momentum, but procurement has an end-of-month blackout.

Attachments: Pilot_results_summary.pdf (pilot logs, latency p95, token cost snapshot)

—Samir
Samir Iqbal
Director, Platform Integrations
OliveTech
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Samir Iqbal <samir@olivetech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OliveTech evaluation cadence & requested cutover extension

Samir — thanks for the update and the clear asks. Appreciate the pilot data. Short answers: we can accommodate a shift, and we should lock in pricing if the deal paper is signed within a reasonable window. Long answer below and proposed next steps.

Proposed MAP (high level; I'll drop a spreadsheet in a follow-up):
1) Security artifact handoff (today–2026-07-24) — Kimberly to own delivery of SOC2 evidence + short Q&A window with OliveTech SecOps.
2) Pilot acceptance (2026-07-28) — OliveTech to confirm acceptance criteria in writing.
3) Procurement / PO target (2026-08-20) — OliveTech to route PO; Redwood to prepare invoice and SOW templates.
4) Cutover / onboarding week (2026-09-01 — 2026-09-07) — dedicated onboarding slot, one-week hypercare.

Contingency options (so we don't lose momentum):
- Short-term sandbox extension (no additional cost) for 30 days if procurement signoff is in progress.
- Priority SOC review (we can fast-track a Redwood SecOps call after Kimberly uploads artifacts).
- A conditional pricing hold: if contract is executed by 2026-08-15 we will honor current pricing; beyond that we'd need an executive review.

Kimberly / Laura — can you confirm you can own the artifact handoff and SOC Q&A? I will draft the MAP and a 1-page contingency note we can cc into procurement. Samir — if you can give me procurement's blackout window details we will align dates.

Regards,

Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OliveTech evaluation cadence & requested cutover extension

Adding a short risk log and evidence plan — copying Samir so OliveTech can see the commitments.

Risk register (new entries):
- R1: Procurement blackout (impact: timeline slip) — mitigation: sandbox extension and conditional pricing hold; owner: OliveTech procurement / Dylan; residual impact: schedule slip to 2026-09-01.
- R2: SOC2 artifact gaps (impact: onboarding delay) — mitigation: prioritized SecOps call, 48-hour clarifying window; owner: Kimberly; residual impact: 3–5 day review tail.
- R3: Pilot regression on longer sequences (impact: acceptance delay) — mitigation: run focused pilot with 3 longest templates, Redwood to provide optimized quantization profile; owner: Laura; residual impact: minor tuning required.

Attachments I uploaded: OliveTech_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP with dates and owners), SOC2_evidence_package.zip (redacted artifacts we use for SecOps review).

Approvals needed from Redwood leadership:
- Approve 30-day sandbox extension at no charge if procurement is actively routing PO (Dylan to confirm docs).
- Approve conditional pricing hold through 2026-08-15 (exec signoff required if beyond).

Dylan — I can run the SecOps call Wed afternoon (2026-07-22) if that works for OliveTech. Laura — please attach the brief regression test plan to the MAP before I send.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Samir Iqbal <samir@olivetech.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, OliveTech Procurement <procurement@olivetech.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OliveTech evaluation cadence & requested cutover extension

Dylan / Kimberly — confirmation: procurement will not be able to finalize the PO until the first week of August due to an end-of-month freeze. Security would like the SecOps call on 2026-07-22 as suggested.

We agree to the proposed MAP milestones and appreciate the sandbox extension offer. Two asks from our side to proceed:
1) Please circulate the updated MAP (OliveTech_MAP_v3.xlsx) with owners and explicit sign-off checkboxes.
2) Can Redwood confirm in writing the pricing hold through 2026-08-15 and the one-week onboarding window starting 2026-09-01 if the PO is signed? We need that for our procurement packet.

If those are in place we'll plan the PO routing week of 2026-08-03 and target a 2026-09-01 cutover. Please send a DocuSign for the SOW once pricing hold is confirmed.

Thanks — Samir

--
